class.name: com.sithaso.b4a.components.B4AChipGroup
class.event: ChipCheckedChange (Key As String, Checked As Boolean)
class.comment: Google Native Material ChipGroup container with String Key-Value pairs and eye-friendly theme presets. Supports multi-selection, single-choice filter chips, closeable action tags, leading icons, dynamic multi-row flow wrapping, and custom Object tags. Example setup: Sub Globals Private B4AChipGroup1 As B4AChipGroup End Sub Sub Activity_Create(FirstTime As Boolean) Activity.LoadLayout("Layout") B4AChipGroup1.Clear B4AChipGroup1.Theme = "Emerald" ' Options: Primary, Emerald, Amber, Rose, Purple, Teal, Dark, Custom B4AChipGroup1.AddChip("all", "All Categories") B4AChipGroup1.AddChip2("tech", "Technology", True, True, True) B4AChipGroup1.AddChip2("science", "Science", True, True, False) B4AChipGroup1.AddChip2("ai_ml", "AI & ML", True, True, False) B4AChipGroup1.AddChip2("mobile", "Mobile Dev", True, False, False) End Sub Sub B4AChipGroup1_SelectionChanged (CheckedKeys As List) For Each key As String In CheckedKeys Log("Selected Key: " & key & " -> " & B4AChipGroup1.GetChipText(key)) Next End Sub Sub B4AChipGroup1_ChipClose (Key As String) Log("Closed tag: " & Key) B4AChipGroup1.RemoveChip(Key) End Sub

method.name: DesignerCreateView
method.comment: Internal hook called by LayoutBuilder to apply Visual Designer properties.

method.name: IsInitialized
method.comment: Returns True if the view object has been initialized.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initializes the B4AChipGroup view programmatically. Example: Dim cg As B4AChipGroup cg.Initialize(Activity, "B4AChipGroup1") Activity.AddView(cg, 10dip, 10dip, 100%x - 20dip, 120dip)

method.name: ApplyTheme
method.comment: Applies a curated theme palette to all new chips created in this group. Theme presets: "Primary", "Emerald", "Amber", "Rose", "Purple", "Teal", "Dark". Example: B4AChipGroup1.ApplyTheme("Emerald")

method.name: SetDefaultColors
method.comment: Sets custom default colors for newly created chips when Theme is Custom. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetDefaultColors(0xFFEFF6FF, 0xFF2563EB, 0xFF1E40AF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFF93C5FD)

method.name: SetChipCheckedColors
method.comment: Customizes resting and checked colors for a specific chip. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipCheckedColors("tech", 0xFFEFF6FF, 0xFF2563EB, 0xFF1E40AF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFF93C5FD)

method.name: FitHeight
method.comment: Measures and resizes the container height to perfectly fit all wrapped rows of chips without clipping. Example: B4AChipGroup1.FitHeight

method.name: AddChip
method.comment: Adds a simple checkable filter chip with a unique String key and display label text. Example: B4AChipGroup1.AddChip("tech", "Technology")

method.name: AddChip2
method.comment: Adds a configurable chip with String key, specifying whether it is checkable, closeable, and checked by default. Example: ' Add a closeable filter chip that is checked by default B4AChipGroup1.AddChip2("ai_ml", "AI & Machine Learning", True, True, True)

method.name: AddChip3
method.comment: Adds a fully customized chip with String key, leading icon and custom trailing close icon bitmaps. Example: Dim icon As Bitmap = LoadBitmap(File.DirAssets, "tag_icon.png") B4AChipGroup1.AddChip3("featured", "Featured", True, True, False, icon, Null)

method.name: AddChipWithTag
method.comment: Adds a chip with an associated custom Object tag value (e.g. Map, custom Type, or User ID). Example: Dim userProps As Map = CreateMap("id": 101, "role": "admin") B4AChipGroup1.AddChipWithTag("user_101", "Admin User", userProps, True, True, False)

method.name: RemoveChip
method.comment: Removes the chip with the given String key from the group. Example: B4AChipGroup1.RemoveChip("tech")

method.name: Clear
method.comment: Removes all chips from the group and resets key mappings. Example: B4AChipGroup1.Clear

method.name: Check
method.comment: Programmatically checks/selects the chip with the given String key. Example: B4AChipGroup1.Check("tech")

method.name: Uncheck
method.comment: Programmatically unchecks/deselects the chip with the given String key. Example: B4AChipGroup1.Uncheck("tech")

method.name: ClearCheck
method.comment: Clears all chip selections in the group. Example: B4AChipGroup1.ClearCheck

method.name: IsChecked
method.comment: Returns True if the chip with the given String key is currently checked. Example: If B4AChipGroup1.IsChecked("tech") Then Log("Technology is active") End If

method.name: GetKeyAt
method.comment: Returns the String key of the chip at the given zero-based child index. Example: Dim firstKey As String = B4AChipGroup1.GetKeyAt(0)

method.name: GetChipText
method.comment: Returns the display text of the chip with the specified String key. Example: Dim label As String = B4AChipGroup1.GetChipText(Key)

method.name: SetChipText
method.comment: Updates the display text of the chip with the specified String key. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipText("tech", "Tech & Gadgets")

method.name: GetChipTag
method.comment: Gets the custom Object tag value attached to the chip with the given String key. Example: Dim tagValue As Object = B4AChipGroup1.GetChipTag("user_101")

method.name: SetChipTag
method.comment: Attaches a custom Object tag value to the chip with the given String key. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipTag("tech", CreateMap("category_id": 42))

method.name: SetChipVisible
method.comment: Sets whether the chip with the specified String key is visible. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipVisible("science", False)

method.name: SetChipEnabled
method.comment: Sets whether the chip with the specified String key is enabled for interaction. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipEnabled("tech", False)

method.name: SetChipColors
method.comment: Customizes the background color, text color, and border stroke color for an individual chip. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipColors("tech", Colors.RGB(230, 240, 255), Colors.Blue, Colors.Blue)

method.name: SetChipIcon
method.comment: Sets or updates the leading icon for the chip with the specified String key. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipIcon("tech", LoadBitmap(File.DirAssets, "star.png"))

method.name: SetChipCloseIconVisible
method.comment: Sets whether the close/dismiss icon is visible for the specified chip. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipCloseIconVisible("tech", True)

method.name: SetChipSpacing
method.comment: Sets the horizontal and vertical spacing between chips in dips. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SetChipSpacing(12, 10)

method.name: BringToFront
method.comment: Brings the view to the front of its parent container.

method.name: SendToBack
method.comment: Sends the view to the back of its parent container.

method.name: RemoveViewFromParent
method.comment: Removes this view from its parent container.

method.name: SetLayout
method.comment: Changes the view bounds immediately.

method.name: SetLayoutAnimated
method.comment: Smoothly animates the view to the specified position and dimensions.

method.name: SetVisibleAnimated
method.comment: Smoothly fades the view visibility in or out.

property.name: Theme
property.comment: Gets or sets the curated theme preset (Primary, Emerald, Amber, Rose, Purple, Teal, Dark, Custom). Example: B4AChipGroup1.Theme = "Emerald"

property.name: SingleSelection
property.comment: Gets or sets whether only one chip can be selected at a time (radio button behavior). Example: B4AChipGroup1.SingleSelection = True

property.name: SelectionRequired
property.comment: Gets or sets whether at least one chip must always remain selected. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SelectionRequired = True

property.name: SingleLine
property.comment: Gets or sets whether chips are laid out in a single horizontal row or multi-line wrapped. Example: B4AChipGroup1.SingleLine = False ' Multi-row flow wrapping

property.name: AutoFitHeight
property.comment: Gets or sets whether the group automatically expands its container height to fit all wrapped chip rows. Example: B4AChipGroup1.AutoFitHeight = True

property.name: CheckedKey
property.comment: Returns the String key of the currently checked chip in SingleSelection mode, or "" if none is selected. Example: Dim activeKey As String = B4AChipGroup1.CheckedKey

property.name: CheckedKeys
property.comment: Returns a List of String keys of all currently checked chips in multi-selection mode. Example: For Each key As String In B4AChipGroup1.CheckedKeys Log("Checked Key: " & key) Next

property.name: NumberOfChips
property.comment: Returns the total number of chips in the group. Example: Dim total As Int = B4AChipGroup1.NumberOfChips

property.name: Left
property.comment: Gets or sets the horizontal position in pixels.

property.name: Top
property.comment: Gets or sets the vertical position in pixels.

property.name: Width
property.comment: Gets or sets the view width in pixels.

property.name: Height
property.comment: Gets or sets the view height in pixels.

property.name: Enabled
property.comment: Gets or sets whether user touch interaction is enabled.

property.name: Tag
property.comment: Gets or sets arbitrary user data attached to this view.
